romania-2024.notes: Source 1 (vjudge 659259): our copy is the live contest page, but its visible part is an unrendered shell; the hidden dataJson lists 14 problems A-N (A MinQ, B Joc Norocos, C Siruri, D Paleogenesis, E Anul vechi, F K-Subsir, G Permutare, H FTW, I Renovare, J Muzeu, K Antrenor, L Club, M K-Special, N 'Joc Norocos backup'), mostly re-used from EOlymp, Gym, CSAcademy and UESTC with sources such as NWERC 2013 and NCPC 2012, and begin/end timestamps 2024-10-20 07:00-12:00 UTC (matches the pack date). The title links the rules and an 'official rank' via short links. Source 3 (Google Sheets pubhtml): only the outer frame was captured; the sheet frame (pubhtml/sheet?headers=false&gid=116684220) needs its own capture to get the standings.

sources.evidence: Virtual Judge contest page titled 'RCPC 2024 - rules: ... official rank: ...' whose visible part is an unrendered app shell (template keys such as 'contest.view.begin' with raw timestamps, an empty status table); the problem list exists only in hidden page data.
Published Google Sheets page 'RCPC 2024 full rank' with one tab 'RCPC rank adjusted'; the sheet itself sits in a frame that our copy does not hold, so the page shows no team or result at all.
